goal: Prepare a proposal for a checklist for documentation task
recommendation: Clarify the target repository or workspace for the checklist

viewpoints.user_value: A checklist ensures that all necessary documentation tasks are completed, enhancing the quality and completeness of the documentation
viewpoints.technical: A clear checklist aids in standardizing documentation processes, making the task more efficient and reducing errors
viewpoints.operations_safety: The checklist helps maintain consistency and reduces the risk of oversights or omissions in documentation
viewpoints.cost_effort: Creating a checklist now will save time and effort in the long term by ensuring all required documentation steps are covered

options.label: A
options.benefit: Define the exact repository or workspace to use for the checklist, ensuring clear responsibility and visibility
options.tradeoff: May require coordination with the relevant stakeholders to identify the appropriate location

options.label: B
options.benefit: Create a generic template that can be adapted to multiple repositories or workspaces, ensuring flexibility
options.tradeoff: May lead to inconsistencies in documentation practices across different repositories

open_questions: Which repository or workspace should receive the checklist?
